Англомовний журнал для іноземців у вашом: An English-language magazine for foreigners in your city wants articles called “Life here through a newcomer's eyes”. Write an article: what surprised you, what you like and what annoys you, and give practical tips to newcomers. Think of a catchy title and speak to the reader directly.
Ваш друг Тарас хоче орендувати квартиру,: Your friend Taras wants to rent a flat, and the owner asks for a reference from someone who knows him well. Write a letter: how long and how you have known Taras, what his qualities are, give real examples and clearly recommend him.
Ви гостювали у знайомих. Напишіть теплу: You stayed with friends. Write a warm thank-you note: say what you liked most and invite them to visit you.
Ви з дружиною забронювали готель в Единб: You and your wife have booked a hotel in Edinburgh for three nights and are travelling by car. Write to the hotel: ask if breakfast is included and what time it is, if there is parking and how much it costs, and if you can check in late in the evening.
Ви отримали замовлення, але товар пошкод: Your order has arrived, but the item is damaged (or it is the wrong size). Write to customer service: give the order number, say what is wrong and what you want (a replacement or a refund).

Write a proposal for the residents: describe the situation now, suggest real changes, estimate the cost and benefits, answer possible objections and suggest next steps.

Напишіть для англомовного блогу рецензію: Write a review for an English-language blog of a book or film you read or saw recently. Introduce it briefly with no spoilers, look at its strengths and weaknesses (plot, characters, style), explain your rating and say who you would recommend it to.
